config.notes: Whitireia and WelTec (Wellington region business division of Te Pukenga / NZIST); host www.whitireiaweltec.ac.nz/study-programmes/; server-rendered text, no page JSON. Header panel: Level N, Start Dates dd/mm/yyyy (Campus), International Start Dates dd/mm/yyyy, Duration, Domestic Fees, International Fees $x[*] [per year] (indicative for YYYY), Credits. Intakes: International Start Dates, or the Start Dates when the page prices an international fee but prints no separate international dates (pick last); term_months maps the page's own mm/yyyy date parts to month names for 2026-2028 (extend each year). Fee: only when printed per year, or when Duration is 1 year full-time (1.5-year Master totals, 18-month diploma totals and 17-week certificate totals are not read). IELTS: first IELTS overall figure in the International students block. Domestic-only pages (no International Fees/Start Dates) give no intakes or fee: they are not offered to international students. Key dates: https://www.whitireiaweltec.ac.nz/about-us/academic-year-dates (2026: Trimester 1 = February, Trimester 2 = July, Trimester 3 = November; 2027 not yet published). English: https://www.whitireiaweltec.ac.nz/enrolment-information/international-enrolments/english-language-requirements (NZQA Rule 18 table). Delivery (mode): the page prints no delivery label; the mode pattern reads only delivery words printed in brackets after a start date or after the Campus label (Distance, online only, Blended), all matches. Pages with a campus name only (Petone, Porirua) give no delivery reading.
